actions_against_the_card.action: 复用已实现SourceAdapter和已有last30days组件中合格部分，不运行其第二watchlist scheduler
actions_against_the_card.delivered: the check drives the existing adapters and the accepted 23-test fixture suite instead of reimplementing; 'no second scheduler' is evidenced by every capture process terminating on its own (slowest 10.2s against a 300s timeout) and by an adapter ticker scan that found none

actions_against_the_card.action: 实际GitHub/论文查询固定问题和时间窗口，分别记录元数据/原文、revision/日期/hash/locator
actions_against_the_card.delivered: real reads: api.github.com releases+commit for a pinned repo window, export.arxiv.org metadata plus the arxiv.org PDF for 2304.03442v2; each item carries url, author, published_at, retrieved_at, upstream_revision, body_sha256, artifact_ref, evidence_id and locator, with request_urls equal to final_urls (no redirect) and the raw page and manifest sealed
actions_against_the_card.evidence: browser/producer-style reports inside .local evidence dir copied as check_direct_two_runs.json; per-run report-*.json paths recorded in the diagnostics

actions_against_the_card.action: 游标在该页落库后推进；重试/转载/重复页面去重不丢来源
actions_against_the_card.delivered: PARTIALLY. The check reads the authoritative SourceCursor out of domain_objects and domain_versions rather than trusting the report, and models the three legitimate outcomes (covered / pending / failed) with a cross-run invariant that refuses a covered window whose page was not complete. Retry is the plan's own two automatic retries with every attempt recorded. Dedup across reposts is carried by the reused fixture tests, not by a live second fetch.
actions_against_the_card.gap_found_by_measurement: a product mutant that deletes the guard 'incomplete page may only advance its page cursor' (internal/domain/sources.go:179-181) passes the entire accepted W07 suite with rc 0 and zero failing lines, so this direction of the rule is unasserted anywhere in the tree - recorded as W07-01-incomplete-page-guard-unasserted in cursor_guard_coverage_gap.json, with why a shallow test was not written instead

actions_against_the_card.action: 验证真实空集与认证/限流/超时/格式失败区分；外部文本不作为工具执行指令
actions_against_the_card.delivered: the distinctions are carried by named existing tests (empty vs auth vs timeout; error page is not a valid empty feed; visible empty vs unrendered), and external-text-inert-ness by the two reject-foreign-redirect-before-request tests plus the sealed-snapshot/allowed-origin test. The check adds an independent recompute row: sha256 over the bytes stored in uploaded_content must equal the digest the report claims, with sealed=1.
